# Supplier Onboarding

## Purpose

Ensure material suppliers are assessed, approved, and integrated with clear ownership and controls.

## Requirements

Onboarding SHOULD identify business owner, purpose, data or access involved, criticality, due-diligence result, contract requirements, integration owner, credentials, monitoring expectations, continuity considerations, and exit conditions.

## Access

Supplier access must follow least privilege and have a defined removal path. Credentials should be supplier-specific where practical rather than shared with personnel.

## Completion

A supplier is not fully onboarded until required contractual, security, privacy, operational, and access actions are complete or explicitly accepted as risk.

See [Supplier Onboarding SOP](../sop/SUPPLIER_ONBOARDING_SOP.md).
